items.title: Effectiveness of Telerehabilitation Versus Conventional Rehabilitation on Motor Function and Activities of Daily Living After Stroke: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of four RCTs (N=226) found that telerehabilitation for stroke patients showed noninferiority compared to conventional rehabilitation for motor function (e.g., Fugl-Meyer change adjusted difference 0.06 points, 95% CI -2.14 to 2.26; p = .96) and activities of daily living.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复对卒中患者的运动功能和日常生活活动（ADL）非劣效于传统康复的证据正在累积。在实践中考虑将远程方案作为替代选择，特别是对于那些难以到院的患者，但仍需注意数据量相对较小。
items.titleZh: 远程康复与传统康复对卒中后运动功能和日常生活活动影响的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 4 项随机对照试验（226 名患者）的系统综述发现，卒中患者的远程康复在改善运动功能（如 Fugl-Meyer 变化调整后差异 0.06 分，95% CI -2.14 至 2.26；p = .96）和日常生活活动方面，与传统面对面康复相比具有非劣效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence is accumulating that telerehabilitation is non-inferior to conventional rehabilitation for motor function and activities of daily living (ADL) in stroke patients. Consider telerehabilitation as an alternative, especially for patients with access barriers, but remain mindful of the relatively small data volume.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入四项 RCT，总样本量 226 人，数据量相对较小，可能限制结果的精确性和普适性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only four RCTs with a total of 226 participants, which is a relatively small data volume and may limit the precision and generalizability of the results.

items.title: Effects of Fingertip Vibrotactile Stimulation on Postural Control in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Comparison Across Age Groups
items.summary: This study of 348 community-dwelling older adults (65-74, 75-84, 85+ years) found that fingertip vibrotactile stimulation improved postural control (measured by center of pressure velocity and area) across all age groups compared to no stimulation.
items.curatedReason: 指尖振动触觉刺激对社区老年人的姿势控制有改善作用，且这种效应在不同年龄组（65-74 岁、75-84 岁、85 岁以上）中持续存在。这提示了该干预作为跌倒预防策略的潜在价值，尤其适用于高龄群体。
items.titleZh: 指尖振动触觉刺激对社区老年人姿势控制的影响：不同年龄组间的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 348 名社区老年人（分为 65-74 岁、75-84 岁和 85 岁以上）的研究显示，指尖振动触觉刺激能够改善所有年龄组的姿势控制（通过足底压力中心速度和面积测量），相对于无刺激条件。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fingertip vibrotactile stimulation improves postural control in community-dwelling older adults, with effects consistent across various age groups (65-74, 75-84, and 85+ years). This suggests its potential value as a fall prevention strategy, particularly for the oldest-old.
items.limitation: 本研究测量的是代偿性姿势控制指标（COP 速度和面积），而非直接的跌倒发生率，且未评估长期效应。
items.limitationEn: This study measured compensatory postural control metrics (COP velocity and area) rather than direct fall incidence, and long-term effects were not assessed.

items.title: Exploring readiness to patient-centered goal-setting in stroke Rehabilitation-A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring perspectives of stroke survivors, caregivers, and physiotherapists on goal-setting in stroke rehabilitation found that goal-setting is largely clinician-led with limited patient and caregiver involvement, identifying themes related to attitudes, uncertainty, communication challenges, and health system factors.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了卒中康复中，患者和照护者在目标设定上的参与度有限，理疗师主导的现象。了解这些视角有助于反思并优化以患者为中心的目标设定流程，更有效地整合患者意愿。
items.titleZh: 探索卒中康复中以患者为中心的目标设定准备度：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究通过访谈 15 名卒中幸存者、7 名照护者和 16 名理疗师，发现卒中康复中的目标设定过程主要由临床医生主导，患者和照护者参与度有限，并揭示了影响目标设定的态度、不确定性、沟通挑战和卫生系统因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals limited patient and caregiver involvement in goal-setting during stroke rehabilitation, often remaining clinician-led. Understanding these perspectives can help optimize patient-centered goal-setting processes and better integrate patient preferences.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（15 名卒中幸存者、7 名照护者、16 名物理治疗师），结果的普遍性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (15 stroke survivors, 7 caregivers, 16 physiotherapists), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Modest Payment Increases Finalized by CMS for SNFs and IRFs
items.summary: CMS finalized modest payment increases for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRFs) for fiscal year 2027, with new rules expected to increase the burden on facilities for delivering, coordinating, and documenting patient care.
items.curatedReason: CMS 最终确定了 2027 财年专业护理机构（SNF）和住院康复机构（IRF）的适度支付增长。虽然增长幅度不大，但新规则增加了设施在患者护理交付、协调和文件记录方面的负担，这直接影响你在这些机构中的执业实践和工作流程。

items.title: Effectiveness and feasibility of home-based physical exercise interventions for children and adolescents with chronic diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published up to December 2025 found home-based physical exercise interventions to be effective and feasible in improving aerobic capacity, functional capacity, muscle strength, and quality of life for children and adolescents with chronic diseases.
items.curatedReason: 对于患有慢性疾病的儿童和青少年，将运动疗法扩展到家庭环境的可行性和有效性一直是我们关注的。这项系统综述明确指出，居家体育锻炼干预能有效改善他们的有氧能力、功能、肌肉力量和生活质量。这意味着你可以更自信地向家长推荐居家运动方案，以支持这些患儿的长期康复。
items.titleZh: 居家体育锻炼干预对患慢性病儿童和青少年的有效性和可行性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项截至 2025 年 12 月的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，居家体育锻炼干预对患慢性病的儿童和青少年在有氧能力、功能能力、肌肉力量和生活质量方面有效且可行。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children and adolescents with chronic diseases, the feasibility and effectiveness of extending exercise therapy to the home setting have been a focus. This systematic review clearly states that home-based physical exercise interventions effectively improve their aerobic capacity, function, muscle strength, and quality of life. This means you can more confidently recommend home exercise programs to parents to support the long-term rehabilitation of these children.
items.limitation: 研究的报告质量评估显示方法学透明度存在不足，可能限制结果的可重复性和可扩展性。
items.limitationEn: The assessment of reporting quality indicated insufficient methodological transparency, potentially limiting the reproducibility and scalability of the results.

items.title: Effects of battle rope training on sporting performance: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the effects of battle rope training on sporting performance, including upper-limb and lower-limb explosive power, grip strength, upper-limb muscular endurance, and core endurance, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 如果你正在为运动员或高水平训练者寻找提升表现的有效方法，战绳训练是一个值得考虑的选择。这项系统综述和荟萃分析确认了战绳训练能显著提高上肢和下肢爆发力、握力、上肢肌肉耐力以及核心耐力。你可以放心地将战绳训练整合到你的训练方案中。
items.titleZh: 战绳训练对运动表现的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析根据 PRISMA 2020 指南，评估了战绳训练对运动表现的影响，包括上肢和下肢爆发力、握力、上肢肌肉耐力和核心耐力。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you are looking for effective ways to enhance performance for athletes or high-level trainees, battle rope training (BRT) is a viable option. This systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that BRT significantly improves upper and lower-limb explosive power, grip strength, upper-limb muscular endurance, and core endurance. You can confidently integrate BRT into your training programs.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析可能存在研究间异质性，影响结果的统一性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity between studies in the meta-analysis may affect the uniformity of the results.
